contentItems.title: Rainy Season Transit Advisory
contentItems.content: Interstate travellers and couriers along South-West and South-South corridors are advised to use moisture-proof cargo encasings.
contentItems.author: Chioma Okonjo

contentItems.title: Reduced 10% Traveller Platform Commission Promo
contentItems.content: We have lowered platform commissions to a flat 10% on all interstate courier trips scheduled throughout October 2026.
contentItems.author: Damilola Ojo

contentItems.title: How does Racvest Escrow protect senders and travellers?
contentItems.content: When a match is agreed, sender funds are held securely in Nigerian bank escrow until the recipient physically inspects the cargo and verifies their one-time release PIN.
contentItems.author: Emeka Nnamani

contentItems.title: Prohibited Cargo and Hazardous Items Policy 2026
contentItems.content: Racvest strictly prohibits arms, ammunition, perishable unpreserved animal produce, illicit narcotics, uncertified bulk chemicals, and undeclared cash exceeding CBN statutory thresholds.
contentItems.author: Folake Balogun

contentItems.title: What should I do if my flight is diverted or delayed?
contentItems.content: Immediately trigger the "Delay / Diversion" alert from your active trip dashboard. This pauses delivery SLA timers and alerts our 24/7 Operations Command desk.
contentItems.author: Babatunde Adeleke
